def resolve(path, cwd, links):
    if not path or not cwd or links is None:
        return None
    
    # Start with the initial path
    if path.startswith('/'):
        current = path
    else:
        current = cwd + '/' + path if cwd != '/' else '/' + path
    
    # Split into components
    components = current.split('/')
    
    # Process components left to right
    resolved = []
    link_count = 0
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(components):
        comp = components[i]
        
        # Skip empty components and '.'
        if comp == '' or comp == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Handle '..'
        if comp == '..':
            if resolved:
                resolved.pop()
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Any other name is appended
        resolved.append(comp)
        
        # Build current canonical path
        canonical_path = '/' + '/'.join(resolved) if resolved else '/'
        
        # Check if this is a symlink
        if canonical_path in links:
            link_count += 1
            if link_count > 8:
                return None
            
            # Get the target of the symlink
            target = links[canonical_path]
            
            # Remove the last component we just added (we'll resolve the target instead)
            resolved.pop()
            
            # Process the target
            if target.startswith('/'):
                # Absolute target: start fresh
                resolved = []
                target_components = target.split('/')
            else:
                # Relative target: relative to the directory containing the link
                # The directory containing the link is the current resolved path before we added the symlink name
                target_components = target.split('/')
            
            # Insert target components at current position for processing
            remaining = components[i + 1:]
            components = target_components + remaining
            i = 0
            continue
        
        i += 1
    
    # Build final result
    if not resolved:
        return '/'
    
    result = '/' + '/'.join(resolved)
    return result
